scope: Reversible removal of Git-backed historical working-copy data in the dedicated P2.1 worktree; guarded subsequent fast-forwards.
status: completed and checked; no proof credit

launcher.reason: The original encoded payload exceeded the service 65536-byte command limit without execution. Regenerate the same manifest in memory and verify its exact bytes/hash before invoking the reviewed script.

checks: Dedicated checkout, branch, HEAD and non-shared worktree index identity.
Each candidate must be an ordinary singly-linked file with exact Git blob bytes, SHA-256 and source-list non-reference checks.
All proof sources, private compiled artifacts, raw logs, acceptance receipts and original native snapshot remain outside the removal set.
Store complete recovery manifest, mark only the 1103 paths skip-worktree, then remove verified copies; Git object data remain available.
Verify index OIDs, mode, stage and skip flags; candidate paths must remain physically absent.
Before and after every permitted fast-forward, verify sparse state and reject any rename-safe diff touching a removed historical path.
Disable Git automatic gc and maintenance for fetch; no cleanup of common repository objects or other worktrees.

verification.reviewer: p21_code_audit; root reviewed and integrated the exact candidate bytes
